notes.title: WISHLIST BUGBOY NOW!
notes.notes:
[h2]We are live![/h2]
The Bugboy Steam store page is live! But you know that of course because you found us here. I thought I'd express my excitement over this with a short announcement post.

[h2]Wishlist campaign[/h2]
While I'm dilligently working on finishing the game the plan is to get word of mouth started with a wishlist campaign. Bugboy has been a passion project a long time in the making and I would love to share it with you as soon as it's ready. By wishlisting the game you'll be notified as soon as there is an update and by garnering wishlists we can ensure Bugboy will be a big success! If you did wishlist, thank you!

[h2]The next steps[/h2]
The first step after launching this Steam store page is to celebrate. After that? Working hard toward our itnended Q1 2025 release! A playable gameplay demo is in the works and will be shared through Steam in the coming months. I'm taking the day off to celebrate this milestone. Talk to you all soon!
